title: HISTORICAL GENESIS OF ART IN THE MIRROR OF WORLD-VIEW AND ARTICULATIVE PRIORITIES
abstract: Main material presentation. Perfection as a target reference point of art is meaningfully correlated with the ideal – the idea of a model, a spiritual expression of the human need to organize, improve, and harmonize the relations between man and nature, man and man, man and society. The ideal performs primarily a regulatory function, serving as a vector that allows us to determine strategic goals, the implementation of which the individual and society are ready to devote their lives to. Conclusions. An adequate understanding of art (in the format of works, phenomena, processes, etc.) is possible only under the conditions of raising the procedure of understanding to the level of art, that is, the art of understanding. It is necessary to understand the calling of art as a historical, personal, and social phenomenon as correctly and fully as possible. It is necessary to realize that such a meaningful and purposeful invariant undergoes significant concrete-historical addition and refinement, due to the worldview-axiological, stylistic and tasteful features of each historical era.

title: ARTISTIC EDUCATION OF A TEACHER IN THE CONDITIONS OF GENERATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
abstract: Main material presentation. The author's concept of the “hermeneutics of authentic aesthetic experience” is introduced and substantiated, serving as the basis for the formation of a specific teacher's “culture of authenticity”. Three key modes of contemporary artistic authenticity are identified and analyzed in detail: genuine (organic, rooted in being), imitative (algorithmic, empty in essence), and hybrid (centauric co-creation of a human and a neural network). Conclusions. The expansion of AI appears not as a death sentence, but as a powerful catalyst for the philosophical renewal of artistic education. Conscious mastery of the culture of authenticity allows the teacher to ethically and critically manage modern modes of creation. The uncompromising assertion of the primacy of the human spirit over algorithmic form becomes a strategic priority for education and a guarantee of preserving the civilizational code.

title: GRIGORII SKOVORODA: A SCHOOL OF THOUGHT AND NOBILITY OF SPIRIT IN THE CONTEXT OF MODERN DIGITAL EDUCATION
abstract: Main material presentation. The educational system requires stable axiological constants that ensure its intrinsic value and meaningful orientation under conditions of dynamic technological change. This involves not only the transformation of curricula and modes of knowledge transmission, but also a reconfiguration of the very idea of education as a cultural phenomenon. The concepts of the “inner self”, “congenial labour”, and “self-knowledge” developed by H. Skovoroda may serve as a conceptual resource for restoring value orientations within contemporary digital education. The use of digital content in teaching philosophical disciplines opens fundamentally new possibilities for organising the educational process. Unlike traditional approaches, which rely primarily on text-centredness and linear logic, digital technologies enable the creation of a polyphonic educational environment. Conclusions. H. Skovoroda’s philosophy constitutes a significant methodological resource and value-based guideline for restoring the axiological dimension of modern education, which is undergoing transformation under the influence of technocratic tendencies and digitalisation. The relevance of the philo

title: THE UNIFIED ORTHODOX CHURCH IN UKRAINE AS A MEGA-GOAL OF OUR NATION: STATE, PROBLEMS, AND MECHANISMS OF ACHIEVEMENT
abstract: Main material presentation. The article analyzes the causes of inter-Orthodox contradictions in Ukraine, assesses the current stage of relations between the Orthodox Church of Ukraine and the Ukrainian Orthodox Church, taking into account the impact of the circumstances of the prolonged Russian-Ukrainian war, and models possible ways to resolve inter-Orthodox tensions and to form a single Local Orthodox Church of Ukraine. Conclusions. The unification of Orthodoxy in Ukraine can be carried out through the efforts of the Ecumenical Patriarchate or the four ancient patriarchates—Constantinople, Alexandria, Antioch, and Jerusalem. Solving this task may also require holding a Pan-Orthodox conference that would develop a model of mutually acceptable unification of Orthodoxy in Ukraine. The author, in turn, expresses views on possible operational actions that could lead the Orthodox believers of our country to unification.

title: INNOVATIVE PEDAGOGICAL TECHNOLOGIES AS A FACTOR IN OPTIMIZING THE HIGHER EDUCATION PROCESS IN THE CONTEXT OF DIGITAL AND SOCIAL TRANSFORMATIONS
abstract: Presentation of the main material. The study confirms that innovative technologies become an effective tool for solving complex educational tasks. They not only develop critical thinking and adaptability but also form professional competencies of future teachers. This occurs through creating a unified interactive space of pedagogical interaction, where students can integrate knowledge and approach real conditions of professional activity. Conclusions. The implementation of innovative technologies optimizes the educational process by expanding collaborative forms of interaction, involving information resources, and diversifying digital tools. The priority direction for modernizing higher education is the systematic implementation of pedagogical innovations and training of personnel capable of effectively managing the pedagogical interaction process in the context of digital transformations and constant changes.

title: ACADEMIC INTEGRITY IN THE CONTEXT OF DISTANCE LEARNING DURING THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC
abstract: Main material presentation. The 21st century is a century of digital breakthroughs and digital technologies that are driving fundamental transformations in all social institutions, as well as in individuals’ consciousness and worldviews. The emergence and rapid development of artificial intelligence technologies have also significantly diversified the nature of how digital society functions. These changes also affect the field of education, as a result of the pandemic and lockdowns – and, in the Ukrainian context, full-scale aggression – offline learning has rapidly shifted to a remote format, transforming into learning that utilizes gadgets and information and computer technologies, resulting in changes to curricula and the modernization of teaching methods, the development of online versions of educational modules, and the transformation of traditional lectures and seminars into webinars (an information and communication technology-based learning method involving interactive remote classes in a synchronous virtual classroom) and web seminars. title: DIGITAL CULTURE AND THE TRANSFORMATION OF HUMANISM IN THE TECHNOLOGICAL AGE
abstract: Main material presentation. Digital culture is interpreted not only as a set of technical skills, but also as a system of values, ethical norms and behavioural models in the digital space. Digital humanism is a conceptual framework that prioritises human values in technological development. The interrelation between these concepts is revealed through the role of education in shaping critical thinking and responsible use of digital technologies. Conclusions. It is established that the formation of digital culture requires a comprehensive approach that combines technological competence with ethical awareness and humanistic values. Digital humanism is a key factor in ensuring the sustainable and human-centred development of digital society.

title: INFORMATION AGENDA AS A FACTOR OF SOCIETAL EFFICIENCY
abstract: Main material presentation. There is little doubt that the information environment is a necessary and, to a large extent, sufficient prerequisite for the materialization of such attributes of the spiritual sphere as worldview priorities, ideas, and values. In the era of the information society, this fact has acquired self-evident, trivial, and realistic features, since it is precisely the informational mobilization of mass consciousness that renders one or another ideological preference nearly uncontested and practically destined for success in terms of mass support. Conclusions. The effectiveness of the information agenda is largely determined by the power of informational and communicative influences, which shape not only the current state of society but also its vision of the future. Contemporary media technologies increasingly rely on manipulative mechanisms, including the imposition of an illusion of freedom, the clichéd structuring of thought, and the substitution of genuinely important issues with secondary or artificially constructed problems. title: PHILOSOPHICAL STRATEGIES OF UKRAINIAN EDUCATION AS A TOOL FOR PRESERVING AND DEVELOPING SCIENCE CAPITAL
abstract: Main material presentation. The article consistently considers the issues of researching the conceptual content of the concept of “science capital” in modern socio-humanitarian discourses, and the analysis of education as a factor in its preservation and development. It was possible to consider it as a component of philosophical and educational studies in connection with the theoretical heritage of P. Bourdieu, to reveal the problems of science capital as a result of involving educational subjects in research activities, to demonstrate the potential of civic science (education), to explore the challenges of preserving and developing science capital precisely in the conditions of socio-cultural upheavals of modern Ukraine. Conclusions. The development of science capital should become the center of educational reforms with the corresponding development of cultural and social capital, the formation of specific behavioral patterns and educational practices in education. title: THE HUMANISTIC POTENTIAL OF ANTEISM IN THE AGE OF THE ANTHROPOCENE
abstract: Main material presentation. The Anthropocene is characterized by a systemic excess of natural resource consumption over the regenerative capacities of ecosystems, which indicates the emergence of a condition of ecological indebtedness to future generations. This dynamic reflects the deepening disruption of the fundamental relationship between humans and the natural world, within which human activity has acquired a planetary scale, affecting not only landscapes but also the functioning of the biosphere as a whole. Under these conditions, there arises a need for a critical rethinking of the idea of human power, traditionally grounded in the notion of unlimited transformation of the world and accompanied by the neglect of its destructive consequences. In this context, anteism emerges as a worldview paradigm that enables the restoration of the understanding of the human as a being rooted in nature and allows for the interpretation of humanity as a historical community responsible for preserving the conditions of its own existence. The appeal to anteism opens the possibility of affirming responsibility toward future generations, while simultaneously actualizing the need for an ecologica

title: PHILOSOPHICAL AND ANTHROPOLOGICAL DIMENSIONS OF MUSEUM REPRESENTATION OF THE OCCUPATION EXPERIENCE: FROM TRAUMA TO MEANING-MAKING
abstract: Main material presentation. For our society, the experience of occupation is not merely a historical fact, but a living reality, which presents the humanities with the task not only of documenting events, but also of deeply reflecting on the experience of occupation as a complex, multi-layered process of transforming individual experience into collective memory. In contemporary Ukrainian exhibitions (for example, the ‘Ukraine – Crucifixion’ project), this is conveyed through the recreation of cramped cellars. Here, the individual is deprived of privacy, light and normal physical activity. The anthropological reduction of the world to the dimensions of a concrete box is a key image that the museum conveys to the visitor. Exhibitions featuring instruments of torture or medical supplies for use in extreme conditions highlight the fragility of the human body. This compels the visitor to feel a sense of physical solidarity with the victim Conclusions. Thus, the museum representation of the experience of war and occupation is a complex, multidimensional process in which anthropological, cultural-existential and ethical dimensions of the transformation of individual traumatic experience i

title: ENOCH AS AN EXISTENTIAL PHENOMENON OF “WALKING WITH GOD”
abstract: Main material presentation. The article provides a comprehensive analysis of biblical texts (Gen. 5:22–24; Heb. 11:5; Jude 14–15) together with the apocalyptic tradition of the Book of Enoch. It is shown that “walking with God” represents a holistic mode of spiritual existence in the constant presence before God (coram Deo). The interpretation in the light of existential philosophy (S. Kierkegaard, K. Jaspers, M. Heidegger, A. Camus) allows Enoch to be understood as a model of existential selfhood. Conclusions. The figure of Enoch appears as an existential phenomenon that unites biblical anthropology, apocalyptic eschatology, and philosophical reflection on human existence. His image reveals faith as a mode of being in the presence of God and as a symbol of hope for overcoming the limits of human life.

title: PATRIARCHATE IN THE UAOC: FROM IDEA TO REALIZATION
abstract: Main material presentation. The stages of the restoration of the highest hierarchy of the UAOC, starting from 1989, are studied. The significance of the All-Ukrainian Orthodox Council of 1990 as the founding act of the proclamation of the Kyiv Patriarchate is analyzed. It is determined that the activities of I. Bodnarchuk provided the organizational basis of the movement, while the figure of Mstislav (Skrypnyk) gave the process canonical continuity and connection with the emigration center. Conclusions. It is established that the formation of the patriarchate in the UAOC was not only a political act, but the result of the systematic activity of the hierarchs, aimed at canonical emancipation from the Moscow Patriarchate. It is proved that the personal contribution of M. Skrypnyk, I. Bodnarchuk and D. Yarema was decisive in the formation of the identity of the modern Ukrainian Orthodox tradition.

title: TRANSFORMATION OF EDUCATIONAL PRACTICES IN THE CONTEXT OF POST-INDUSTRIAL CHALLENGES
abstract: Main material presentation. The post-industrial era is radically transforming the functions of the university: the value of education is increasingly determined not by the volume of acquired information, but by the individual’s ability to act under conditions of uncertainty arising from the technologicalization of contemporary society. The university is gradually moving away from its role as a space for transmitting a fixed body of knowledge and is increasingly emerging as an institution that creates an environment for development: it teaches how to think, collaborate, make responsible decisions, build individual learning trajectories, and sustain professional mobility. This shift necessitates a reconsideration of the content of educational programs, approaches to assessment, and the roles of both teachers and students. In contemporary philosophical and scientific discourse, the concept of AI literacy is being formed as a new component of general literacy alongside digital and information literacy. Within the framework of lifelong learning, micro-credentials acquire particular significance as a tool for the rapid and standardized supplementation of the competence profile. The combi

title: SYNERGY OF CRITICAL, CREATIVE, AND LOGICAL THINKING IN THE ERA OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: A PHILOSOPHICAL AND EDUCATIONAL PERSPECTIVE
abstract: Main material presentation is based on the analysis of logical thinking as the rational foundation of knowledge structuring, critical thinking as a reflective and evaluative mechanism, and creative thinking as a source of meaning-making and innovation. It is argued that their synergy enables a transition from the instrumental application of artificial intelligence to its integration into the culture of human thinking. Conclusions demonstrate that the synergy of critical, creative, and logical thinking is a necessary condition for preserving the humanistic orientation of education in the digital age and creates theoretical prerequisites for returning higher-order problems to scientific discourse and for forming a new integrated intellectual resource capable of addressing complex civilizational challenges.

title: LITERARY IMAGES OF WAR IN MODERN PHILOSOPHICAL PROSE: PHILOSOPHICAL ANALYSIS
abstract: Main material presentation.. The article highlights that philosophical prose—specifically, a literary text—serves as a vehicle for spatial thinking, where the traumatic experience of war introduces new forms of thought, since literary depictions of war have practical reflections and applications in the literary works of contemporary Ukrainian writers. War, as an extreme situation of human existence, introduces destructive shifts in the perception of the categories of time and the subjective perception of world space, which involves the concept of existential emptiness. Contemporary philosophical prose largely attempts to recreate images of war through literary creation, since this subject matter should not be lacking in the representation of war imagery. Conclusions. Based on the analysis conducted in this study, it has been established that literary images of war in contemporary philosophical prose transcend the boundaries of traditional representations of events and acquire the status of an ontological phenomenon. Literary images of war become an event of thought in which philosophical analysis and artistic reflection are combined, forming a new language for describing the extrem

title: FRUITFUL IMAGINATION, HUMANISTIC THINKING AND HUMANISTIC ACTION IN THE CONTEXT OF THE REALIZATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS (approaches of metaanthropology and social metaanthropology)
abstract: Relevance of the research.The relevance of the research topic is due to the fact that in a situation of war, a person feels uncertainty and insecurity, lack of protection, violation of his rights. Important in such a situation is fruitful imagination and humanistic thinking and action, which enables a person to create and implement an image of a positive future. When we create something fruitful in the imagination, humanistically comprehend it and act, the desired becomes real, including in the implementation of human rights. Problem statement. In a modern crisis society, a number of questions are important. What is fruitful imagination? How is it related to humanistic thinking and action, in particular to the implementation and protection of human rights? Analysis of recent research and publications. The problem of imagination and its meaning is raised by M. Ficino and Pico della Mirandola. D. Bruno believes that imagination is capable of opening new worlds, D. Hume notes the importance of imagination in the process of cognition. R. Descartes claims that sensation appears first, and then imagination. I. Kant introduces the concept of productive imagination. title: AXIOLOGICAL TRANSFORMATION OF HIGHER EDUCATION IN THE CONTEXT OF POST-SECULAR SOCIETY
abstract: Relevance of the research. The dominance of the technocratic and secular paradigm of the twentieth century has reduced the humanistic potential of the university to a utilitarian function of training specialists, stripped of its deeper moral dimension. This approach, grounded in the separation of facts and values, has contributed to a systemic crisis of goal-setting, which underscores the need to rethink the very essence of education. Problem statement. In the context of postsecularity – which has revealed the inadequacy of the thesis about the inevitable decline of religion – there emerges a need to restore the axiological dimension of education and to shift from an informational model to a formational one. Analysis of recent research and publications. Contemporary educational discourse increasingly emphasizes the role of spiritual and moral meanings, as well as the phenomenon of value interiorization through the cultural codes of the educational environment, particularly through the “hidden” curriculum. title: THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC: FIRST EXPERIENCE OF LIFE IN A REMOTE FORMAT
abstract: Relevance of the research. For four years now, Ukrainian society has been living in the “here and now” paradigm, realizing the importance of every minute of life, refusing to plan vacations a year in advance, early booking of hotels and plane tickets, and interest in global economic and political forecasts for the coming decades has been replaced by constant monitoring of the presence/absence of threats and current power outage schedules. However, the first experience of living “here and now” was in 2020, when a change in worldview and axiological paradigms took place, and new models of behavior were formed for both humanity as a whole and for individuals. The attractive image of a nomadic person who strives for constant change of location, nurtured and propagated by postmodern philosophy, is transformed in the pandemic-quarantine reality of 2020 into a digital nomad, whose space of existence and activity becomes the Internet. Ukrainian society is using this experience of quarantine restrictions and the “lessons” of living (surviving) during the pandemic in the military realities of 2022-2026, which is why this research is important and relevant. title: SOCIO-POLITICAL FACTORS IN THE FORMATION OF ORTHODOX AUTOCEPHALY: GLOBAL PRACTICE AND THE EXPERIENCE OF UKRAINE
abstract: Relevance of the research is driven by the need to address the spiritual needs of a society that is in the process of searching for ideals and models of self-realization within the new conditions of the global interactive space. Fundamental socio-political transformations occurring recently in the Ukrainian state have actualized interest in the events surrounding the restoration of autocephaly and the possibility of establishing a local (pomisna) Orthodox Church in Ukraine. Problem statement. There is an undeniable interest among researchers in the influence of general socio-political processes on the transformation of Orthodox institutions associated with the collapse of the atheistic Soviet state and the proclamation of Ukraine's independence. In our time, this issue carries not only theoretical but also significant practical importance, given its potential impact on the course of social life both globally and in Ukraine. Analysis of recent research and publications. Conceptually, the following works are crucial for addressing the research objectives: studies by leading Ukrainian religious scholars such as M. title: THE STATE AND SOCIETY IN UKRAINE UNDER THE MAGIC OF CHURCH JURISDICTIONS
abstract: Relevance of the research. The most acute problem of contemporary religious life in Ukraine is the long-standing inter-Orthodox conflict, which has resulted in the simultaneous activity of several Orthodox jurisdictions, the main ones being the Orthodox Church of Ukraine and the Ukrainian Orthodox Church. The unification of these churches constitutes the relevance of this study. Problem statement. The Unification Council held in 2018 in fact led only to a partial unification of these two churches. Without resolving this issue, internal Orthodox problems in Ukraine cannot be settled. Overcoming the existing contradictions requires finding an acceptable form for continuing the unification process within Ukrainian Orthodoxy. Analysis of recent research and publications. Given the acute nature of the issue of restoring Orthodox unity in Ukraine, both domestic and foreign researchers analyze the situation in Ukraine and model possible ways to resolve the existing inter-Orthodox contradictions. title: PECULIARITIES OF USE OF ENTERTAINMENT CONTENT PLATFORMS IN THE EDUCATIONAL PROCESS
abstract: Relevance of the research is due to the crucial educational role in universities and the importance of successful educational process organization which is based on the features of the use of social networks and entertainment content platforms in the educational process, in order to identify the main principles and tasks aimed at overcoming the psycho-emotional load in education during martial law. Problem statement. Clarifying the possibilities of improving the above-mentioned process in modern conditions is the most necessary component of successfully overcoming the consequences of the hostile attack in the field of pedagogy and the formation of the personality of young people in independent Ukraine. Analysis of recent research and publications. Based on the very essence of the current situation, the context of the information field, modern IT capabilities and the nature of the pedagogical process in universities, it should be noted that the development of the scientific approach, and, consequently, the publication content in this area, is taking place right now. title: SOCIOCULTURAL AND GENDER ASPECTS OF PHENOMENON OF IMAGINATION IN HUMAN RIGHTS PHILOSOPHY
abstract: Relevance of the research. In today's world, where gender equality is becoming an ethical and legal imperative, legal philosophy needs to integrate the phenomenon of imagination as a tool for legitimizing the social contract and deconstructing patriarchal norms. Traditional theories (Hobbes, Locke, Rousseau, Habermas) model imagination to justify power and human rights, but ignore its gender dimension, where the authority of the first person (FPA) opposes binary stereotypes, colonial narratives, and violence against subjectivity. In the Ukrainian context, against the backdrop of European integration and military challenges, gender politics is transforming the legal paradigm: from combating stereotypes in legislation to philosophical and legal studies of equality (for example, M. I. Krochuk's dissertation on gender parity). However, the problem of imagination as a resource for decolonizing norms and multiple identities in the philosophy of law remains underdeveloped, despite the growing attention to gender law in the NAU and academic circles. This study fills this gap by proposing a model of legal protection where respect for imagination ensures the decolonization of norms, the expa

title: CORPOREALITY IN THE AGE OF POSTHUMANISM: ANTAEISM AS A HUMAN PRACTICE OF ROOTEDNESS
abstract: Relevance of the research. The beginning of the twenty-first century has been marked by radical transformations in the modes of human existence driven by the accelerated development of technologies, including bioengineering and genetic engineering. These changes have prompted a reconsideration of established conceptions of human nature, corporeality, and the place of the human being within a technologized world. In contemporary philosophical discourse, an increasingly evident shift can be observed from an anthropocentric paradigm toward posthumanist thinking, within which the human body appears not as a given, but as a project — an open field for technological intervention and modification. In this context, the question arises whether human corporeality retains its ontological significance in the age of technological totality. Such a perspective challenges the traditional foundations of humanism, particularly the notions of autonomy, uniqueness, and inviolability of the human form of life as Homo sapiens. It also raises the issue of whether techno-humanism (Y. N. Harari) represents an attempt of humanity to escape from itself. This problem is critically addressed through the princi

title: DESIGN AS FASHION AND A SOCIO-CULTURAL MECHANISM FOR HUMAN SELF-EXPRESSION
abstract: Relevance of the research. In contemporary sociocultural contexts, the concept of design is increasingly moving beyond a purely utilitarian or functional understanding and is becoming more prominent as a sociocultural mechanism of human self-expression. Problem statement. Based on the understanding of fashion as a complex mechanism of symbolic communication and social regulation, the definition of fashion as a component of cultural practices of self-determination, both as consumers and creators of fashion trends and fashion design, remains problematic. Analysis of recent research and publications. The basis for the scientific analysis of fashion is laid down in the works of G. Zimmel, and it is also important to refer to the work of P. Bourdieu and contemporary studies that in one way or another touch upon the problems of fashion as a form of human self-determination. It is worth noting such researchers as V. Derezevich, D. Norman, Yu. Legenky, M. Loseva, I. Ryzhova, V. Shivelbush, and others. Research task. title: RELIGIOUS STUDIES AND EDUCATION IN UKRAINE: ORIGIN, CURRENT STATUS AND DEVELOPMENT TRENDS
abstract: Relevance of the research. Today, the scientific community is actively involved in addressing the issues of religious studies as a science and education in Ukraine. This topic has become a subject of scientific debate among educators, philosophers, theologians, public figures, and religious scholars themselves at numerous conferences; it is also highlighted in publications in reputable journals, defended dissertations, etc. The relevance of the problem under study is by no means new, and the main options for its solution are based on modern theoretical reflections that have lost neither their significance nor their urgency. Problem statement. Possessing substantial theoretical and practical achievements in the field of religious studies, the scientific community is searching for ways to resolve the task of its own self-identification. Today, the fact of the existence of religious studies within the national scientific and educational space proves to be more important than constant disputes over the boundaries of the problem field of the science of religion or the development of a unified system of methodological tools. title: ICON IN THE LITURGICAL SPACE
abstract: Relevance of the research. The icon should be interpreted not only as a stationary object of decor in the church, but as a living image of the liturgical space, which combines cultural, artistic, symbolic and theological dimensions. Problem statement. The liturgical space can be conceived as a system that comprises architecture, iconography, liturgical action, and even decorative decoration. They are always interacting with each other in a continuous manner. We find that the chief function of the icon in the liturgical space and its structure-forming role still constitute the issue of great import. Analysis of recent research and publications. M. Balytska clearly informs that today's Ukrainian painters and iconographers, adhering to important basic principles, are actively working on the transformation of traditional means of artistic expression in iconography. Citing the thoughts of O. Tsuhork, it can be understood that modern Ukrainian icon painting aptly combines traditional canonicity with original aesthetic approaches. In this case, changes in the use of chiaroscuro effects, color scheme, texture and plasticity of images are of significant importance. Research task. The purpos

title: AXIOLOGICAL PRINCIPLES OF SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT: A SOCIO-PHILOSOPHICAL ANALYSIS
abstract: Relevance of the research. The relevance of the research is due to the growth of global environmental, social and technological challenges, which actualize the need for a philosophical rethinking of sustainable development not only as a management or economic strategy, but as a holistic axiological project. Problem statement. In modern scientific discourse, there is a methodological and conceptual disconnect between the analysis of individual values and their holistic socio-philosophical understanding in the context of global transformations caused by digitalization, technological acceleration and the growth of environmental risks, which complicates the understanding of sustainable development as a coherent system of ethical guidelines. Analysis of recent research and publications. The issue of sustainable development has been thoroughly understood in the works of Ukrainian researchers, in particular M. Boychenko, L. Gorbunova, L. Horoshkova, V. Zinchenko, L. Kalinichenko, O. Kyvlyuk, O. Polishchuk, N. Petruk and others. Research task. title: IMPLEMENTATION OF REGULATORY AND LEGAL REQUIREMENTS OF INCLUSIVE DESIGN THROUGH THE PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCE FORMATION SYSTEM OF FUTURE TEACHERS
abstract: Relevance of the research. In activities based on the principles of inclusive design, the future teacher acquires a new professional quality — the ability to see the world through the lens of diversity and accessibility. This is a unique type of professional activity that reveals the ethical, cognitive and creative qualities of a teacher, because designing an inclusive educational environment requires a high level of awareness and responsibility before the law. In the process of forming this competence, intellectual flexibility, emotional sensitivity and legal culture of the student's personality develop. Compliance of teacher training with regulatory and legal requirements of inclusive design becomes not only a requirement of time, but also a guarantee of building an open and fair educational space. Problem statement. Despite the rapid updating of the legal framework regarding barrier-free accessibility, in the system of higher pedagogical education there is a contradiction between the legislative requirements of inclusive design and the real level of readiness of graduates for their implementation in the educational process. title: IMAGINATION AND HUMAN RIGHTS: HISTORY OF PHILOSOPHY AND THE PRESENT
abstract: Relevance of the research. The connection between imagination and human rights is very relevant in the era of existential war and the acquisition of a just peace. It is obvious that in this context this is a question of imagination, which exists in its openness to the Other. Problem statement. Imagination allows us to construct the future, to experience the symbolic and artistic. Human rights are one of the fundamental ideas of European civilization, which expresses the idea of the dignity, freedom and equality of people. The problem of openness to the Other concerns the limits of subjectivity, the possibility of dialogue. Analysis of recent research and publications. The problem of imagination in its combination with the issue of openness to the Other and human rights is encountered in the works of O. Dobrodum, N. Dresvyannikova, O. Kivlyuk, S. Krylova, who explore the existential and socio-cultural aspects of such a combination. Research task. title: INTEGRATION OF DIGITAL EDUCATIONAL TECHNOLOGIES INTO THE PROFESSIONAL TRAINING OF FUTURE PRIMARY SCHOOL TEACHERS
abstract: Relevance of the research. The relevance of our research is determined by the rapid changes in the educational environment under the influence of the digitalization process. The requirements for modern primary school teachers are changing the forms and methods of professional training for future educators. In today's world, a teacher's digital competence is becoming a basic requirement for ensuring a high-quality educational process. Therefore, traditional methods of training future primary school teachers are losing their effectiveness, which requires higher education institutions to promptly search for and implement innovative forms of interaction. The need to integrate various types of digital educational technologies (DET) into the professional training of future primary school teachers is one of the priority tasks of modern pedagogical science. Problem statement. The problem of training future primary school teachers lies in the existing contradiction between the rapid development of digital educational technologies (including AI tools) and their insufficient integration into the educational process of higher education institutions. title: PHENOMENOLOGY OF DIGITAL LONELINESS IN WAR CONDITIONS: BETWEEN ALGORITHMIC HYPERPRESENCE AND EXISTENTIAL ISOLATION
abstract: Relevance of the research. The article provides a phenomenological analysis of digital loneliness as a specific form of experiencing isolation in the conditions of algorithmic hyper-presence and military reality. The paradox of “digital isolation” is revealed, in which the increase in the number of virtual contacts is accompanied by the erosion of the depth of interpersonal interaction. The mechanisms of upward social comparison, the FOMO phenomenon, and the displacement of bodily-emotional communication by digital practices are analyzed. Special attention is paid to the distinction between active and passive patterns of online interaction and their impact on the structure of the subjective experience of loneliness. Based on the analysis of modern empirical research, the potential of digital hygiene practices as a means of restoring the existential and social integration of the individual is substantiated. The transformation of the communicative space has led to the ambivalent impact of social media on the individual. title: THE THEORETICAL AND METHODOLOGICAL POTENTIAL OF IMAGINATION IN THE ACTIVITIES OF A LAW-ABIDING MANAGER WHEN EXERCISING MANAGERIAL INFLUENCE
abstract: Relevance of the research topic. Imagination as a psychological resource for managerial influence is of key importance in the context of the transformation processes in Ukrainian society, ensuring a balance between creativity and ethical leadership. Problem statement: The study confirms the potential of imagination for shaping a law-abiding manager capable of integrating creative ideas and hypothetical scenarios into real processes without disrupting the stability of the managed society and without questioning the legitimacy of power. Analysis of recent research and publications. This issue was considered by well-known Ukrainian scientists: A. Lutsky, V. Noskov, A. Kalyanov, O. Efrosinina, O. Yurkov. Among foreign researchers, we highlight: V. M. Bass and B. J. Avolio, A. Bandura, V. H. Vroom, J. Rawls, L. Kohlberg. Research task. The aim of the study was to explore the potential of imagination to strengthen managerial influence within the framework of ethical leadership and the activities of a law-abiding manager. Main material presentation. In an activity context, a person often has to be not just an executor of clear instructions and rules, but in some cases, to show creativity

title: ONTOLOGICAL STATUS OF VIRTUAL REALITY: FROM SIMULATION TO NEW SUBJECTIVITY
abstract: Relevance of the research. Contemporary transformations in society require a reconsideration of life space beyond its functional and technological modernization. In the context of digitalization, it becomes necessary to interpret virtual environments not merely as technical or aesthetic solutions, but as anthropologically significant factors influencing the formation of human subjectivity and life-creative experience. Problem statement. A contradiction arises between the rapid implementation of innovative digital solutions and the insufficient philosophical reflection on their impact. The influence of architectural, technological, and symbolic components of virtual reality on autonomy, communication, and embodied-sensory experience remains insufficiently conceptualized. Analysis of recent research and publications. The theoretical framework draws upon the phenomenological understanding of lived space developed by M. Merleau-Ponty, the symbolic interpretation of culture by E. Cassirer, and the critical analysis of institutional space by M. Foucault. title: PHILOSOPHY OF EDUCATIONAL SPACE DESIGN IN THE LIFE-CREATING EXPERIENCE OF A CHILD
abstract: Relevance of the research. Contemporary transformations in education require a reconsideration of educational space beyond its functional and technological modernization. In the context of digitalization and hybrid learning formats, it becomes necessary to interpret spatial design not merely as a technical or aesthetic solution, but as an anthropologically significant factor influencing the formation of children’s subjectivity and life-creative experience. Problem statement. A contradiction arises between the rapid implementation of innovative spatial solutions and the insufficient philosophical reflection on their impact on the child’s mode of being. The influence of architectural, technological, and symbolic components of educational space on autonomy, communication, and embodied-sensory experience remains insufficiently conceptualized. Analysis of recent research and publications. title: FROM THE UNIVERSITY AS A TEMPLE OF KNOWLEDGE TO THE UNIVERSITY AS A NETWORKED CENTER OF INNOVATION
abstract: Relevance of the research. The traditional understanding of the university as a “temple of knowledge”, embodying spiritual and humanistic values, academic autonomy and the classical model of education, is gradually changing. The university is moving to a new type of functioning - a network center of innovation, where knowledge is not only transmitted, but also actively created in interaction with digital platforms, business, technological clusters and global scientific communities. The relevance of the topic is due to the fact that education and science are becoming key factors in the development of a knowledge society, and the university is a central element of this system. However, its classical paradigm, based on the lecture-auditorium model, is increasingly less responsive to the challenges of the digital age. There is a need for a philosophical rethinking of the mission of the university as an intellectual, social and innovative node of a network society, which ensures sustainable development, produces creative capital and forms new ethical guidelines. title: TECHNICAL CREATIVITY AS THE ART OF BEING: TOWARDS THE ISSUE OF NATIONAL-PATRIOTIC EDUCATION (PHILOSOPHICAL AND ECOLOGICAL ASPECT)
abstract: Relevance of the research. The appeal to the issue of technical creativity as the art of being is determined by the ongoing transformational processes that humanity experiences under the conditions of technological modernity. This makes it possible to speak about the formation of the technological human — a being who is not only the creator of technology but also continues themselves within it. At the same time, the means and forms of technical action are defined not only by the requirements of the community but also by the inner ethical choice of the individual. As a source of social development, techne reveals the human as a demiurge who creates new forms of being, while the true uniqueness of technology lies in its ambivalence — improvement and destruction. Therefore, the ultimate goal of technology should consist not only in substantiating the functional efficiency of social existence but also in the perfection of being itself. This defines the main task of modern culture — to change the vector of technical creativity, overcoming the fallacy of understanding it exclusively within the limits of applied practice. title: ETHICS AND HUMAN RIGHTS IN THE DIGITAL SOCIETY
abstract: Relevance of the research. In today’s world, digital technologies have become an integral part of societal development, permeating virtually all spheres of life—from education and the economy to healthcare and public administration. Ethics delineates the moral boundaries of their use, while human rights provide legal safeguards. Studying this topic is essential for understanding contemporary transformations and for developing effective public policy and societal self-regulation. Problem statement. Rapid digitalization is radically transforming data collection and use, public communications, and decision-making, while simultaneously heightening the risks of privacy violations, illicit circulation of personal data, media manipulation, corporate–state control, and digital inequality. Today, amid the formation of new values, ethical issues are particularly relevant and necessary, which is why this problem has come to the fore for study. Analysis of recent research and publications. Issues of ethics, universal moral norms, freedom, equality, responsibility, and dignity have been examined by scholars such as Zh. Andriichenko, N. title: THEORETICAL AND METHODOLOGICAL PROBLEMS OF PSYCHOLOGICAL RESEARCH OF PERSONALITY ON THE EXAMPLE OF STUDYING THE CONFLICT BETWEEN THE ALTER EGO AND THE SUPEREGO IN INTRAPERSONAL COMMUNICATION
abstract: Relevance of the research topic. The study of intrapersonal communication, in particular the conflict between the alter ego and the super ego of the subject, is extremely relevant in the context of modern socio-political and psychosocial conditions that have developed in Ukraine. In times of war, prolonged socio-economic instability, security threats, large-scale migration, losses and collective traumatization, the mental health of the nation becomes one of the key resources for survival and recovery. Understanding the mechanisms of self-regulation, internal dialogue and personal integration is of particular importance, where the conflict between the alter ego (as an alternative image of the “I”) and the super ego (as an internal moral censor) plays a decisive role. The analysis of this internal conflict allows us to more deeply understand the nature of stress, feelings of guilt, internal pressure or dissatisfaction with oneself, as well as to outline ways to achieve personal integrity. title: ECONOMIC SECURITY IN THE CONTEXT OF GEOPOLITICAL CHALLENGES: RISKS AND COUNTERACTION STRATEGIES
abstract: Relevance of the research. For Ukraine, the relevance of the topic is enhanced by the need to develop a long-term model of economic recovery and modernization, which would be based on the principles of sustainability, economic sovereignty, social security and integration into the European security space. In the EU countries, in turn, there is a growing awareness of the need to strengthen economic and energy security, adaptation to the new reality, where the policy of “soft power” no longer ensures stability. Therefore, the issue of economic security is becoming key for the formation of modern economic policy of both Ukraine and the European Union. Problem statement. Modern economic challenges require a new scientific paradigm — an integrative model of security economics, which would allow states to maintain stability and competitiveness, providing protection from threats and creating a basis for long-term development. Analysis of recent research and publications. The issue of economic security is considered in various conceptual planes, for example, during the period of F. Roosevelt's “New Deal”, when economic stabilization was considered an element of national security in the USA.
